Class.name: IHC.ITF.Service.TelcorBillingReportAlertScheduler
Class.Description:
This service is used to send Success or Failure email of prior dates Billing transactions sent to Telcor. This service looks at the Global set by the Billing Process to get number of records not successfuly sent/outstanding to be sent to Telcor. Name of the globals are ^TELCORBILLINGCOUNTER and ^TELCORBILLINGSENDCOUNTER .
. ^TELCORBILLINGCOUNTER contains count of total record sent to Telcor operation and ^TELCORBILLINGSENDCOUNTER countains count of Total telcor record successfuly sent by operation . If the If the difference in count of ^TELCORBILLINGCOUNTER and ^TELCORBILLINGSENDCOUNTER is greater than 0 means that many records did not get sent to the Telcor

Parameter.name: ADAPTER
Parameter.Description: Use the Adapter to invoke this service every set amount of time

Property.name: SuccessEmailSubject
Property.Description:
This is the subject to use on the success email.
It also uses replacement constants #FORDATE and #OUTSTANDINGCOUNT and if present it replaces with the Count in Global ^TELCORBILLINGCOUNTER and the date of report

Property.name: SucessEmailBody
Property.Description:
Email This is the body that will be included in the success email.
It also uses replacement constants #FORDATE and 3OUTSTANDINGCOUNT and if present it replaces with the Count in Global ^TELCORBILLINGCOUNTER and the date of report

Property.Description:
This is the subject to use on the failure email.
It also uses replacement constants #FORDATE and #OUTSTANDINGCOUNT and if present it replaces with the Count in Global ^TELCORBILLINGCOUNTER and the date of report

Property.Description: Source sytem whose global needs to be read and alert generated
